title: Whether he would still perform without his stroke
summary: He says he would still be dancing and singing but for the stroke.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, if it weren't for your stroke would you still be performing?
Do you feel that you'd still be dancing?
Do you think you'd concentrate more on singing?

No, I wouldn't concentrate on nothin', I'd just keep doing what I've been doin'. It would cost me more -- easier to sing than to dance, it would be different, but if I find as much pleasure in dancing than singing, I'd be dancing.
